Entities / Vehicles / Hcs Surety

HCS Surety

Read Aloud

A small Crown patrol cutter rides low in the water, painted naval grey with a white stripe at the waterline and a brass registry plate fixed to the bow. Two cannon sit amidships, with swivel guns fore and aft, and the Crown pennant flies from the masthead. The ship shows patrol wear: salt-caked seams, lifting copper at the bow, and the tired look of a vessel overdue for proper dock work.

Registry No. CS-1147. Now sailing as the Uncertainty under private colours.

Overview

A Tier 1 Dravosi patrol cutter built for inspection, pursuit, and boarding rather than sustained ship-to-ship combat. Lighter-armed than HCS Relentless but dangerous at close range. Assigned to the eastern Crown Island waypoints under Barnaby Rook on Crown commission.

The hull was worn but sound at time of capture. Caulking overdue on two strakes, copper sheathing lifting at the bow. Interior reflected Crown patrol service: officer cabin aft, crew hammocks forward, boarding locker amidships, chart table forward, two-prisoner cage bolted below.

Crew (At Time of Capture)

Barnaby Rook commanded 8 privateer ratings on Crown commission — loyalty to Rook’s pay more than the Crown. If Rook defeated or yielded, DC 13 Persuasion convinced them to stand down; failure meant they tried to flee in the jolly boat.

Notable: Cap’n Gorgeous (enforcer, killed Session 01); Geoffrey Draves (ship’s carpenter, defected to party Session 01).

Crown Recognition Clock

The Surety was registered out of Port Tidefall under Lieutenant B. Rook.

  • Weeks 1–2: No action. Patrol cutters sometimes run long without check-in.
  • Week 3: Harbourmaster’s Register flags as overdue. Query to nearest Crown waypoint.
  • Week 4–5: Listed missing. Description circulated to Eastern Crown Islands ports.
  • Week 6+: If spotted under Crown colours — boarding authorised. If under different colours and identified by hull or crew — wanted vessel at Crown ports.

See Surety — Crown Search for the active situation. See DM Guide for full chase and recognition tooling.

Session Log

SessionDevelopment
Session 01Party boarded the Surety alongside the Saltwright. Cap’n Gorgeous killed in the hold. Rook blasted off the gangplank by Jean-Claude’s Flask of Endless Water, hauled back, fired at Beaumont — deflected. Geoffrey Draves surrendered, defected to party after Delmar offered the choice.
Session 02Heading for Calveno under Crown colours with assembled crew. Shepherd Grigori found in the galley with table already set — met his threshold, shared intelligence about Cap’n Gorgeous and Rupert Knighton.
Session 03Whip shark over sixty feet long struck the hull three times in a storm. Two inches of water in the bilge. Party killed it; Jean-Claude and Sem Holst patched the hull with Mending and shark scales over five days. Figurehead gone. Party renamed her Uncertainty on approach to Calveno. Docked at La Vasca under Cobb’s supervision.
